items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: the drummer, Buddy Saltzman, who played on pretty much all The Four Seasons’ hits, said to me, “Charlie,” he said, “there’s going to be four stages to your career.”

ctx.x: So then obviously when The Four Seasons became successful I became the arranger which gave me opportunity, and then my name was on records. And making a Four Seasons record, one of the – the drummer, Buddy Saltzman, who played on pretty much all The Four Seasons’ hits, said to me, “Charlie,” he said, “there’s going to be four stages to your career.” He said: Who’s Charlie Calello? We have to get Charlie Calello. What we need is a young Charlie Calello. And whatever happened to Charlie Calello.
Well I’m glad to have you here. Here’s what happened. That’s terrific. Was there a point where you said, “Hmm, I should be getting paid for this, and how much, and how do I charge?”
